comment: carbonio-mailbox-sdk native-image metadata. MailboxInternalApiClient talks to the mailbox
internal API through a Retrofit client: it builds a JDK dynamic proxy over InternalApi
(Retrofit.create -> Proxy.newProxyInstance) and its converter reflectively reads the response
DTOs. GraalVM needs BOTH registered — without the proxy every mailbox lookup fails at runtime
with MissingReflectionRegistrationError (seen in RestIT native); without the DTOs the converter
would deserialise them to null (silent, the way docs-connector's QuotaStatus did). The mailbox-sdk
ships no native metadata of its own, so user-management registers exactly what InternalApi uses.
Same pattern docs-connector uses for the Powerstore-SDK Retrofit client.
PROXY: the Retrofit service interface. DTOs: AccountInfo (record; getMyAccountInfo / getAccountInfo
/ getAccountByEmail / batchGetAccounts) with its nested AccountStatus enum; SharedAccount and
MailUsage (other InternalApi return types); BatchRequest (batch request body, serialised).
